name: clock
note: curr_time is present whenever Feature::CurrentTimeReminder is enabled. sleep is only appended to the same coalesced 'clock' namespace when config.current_time_reminder.sleep_tool is also set.
description: Tools for reading and waiting on time.

tools.name: curr_time
tools.description: Return the current time in UTC.

tools.name: sleep
tools.description: Pause execution for a specified duration. The sleep ends early when new input arrives for the active turn. Returns the elapsed wall-clock time.

duration_ms.description: How long to sleep in milliseconds. Must be between 1 and 43200000.
